name: Spur Corporation Ltd
source: Consolidated audited annual financial statements for the financial year ended 30 June 2026 (PricewaterhouseCoopers Inc.), Spur Corporation Limited, consolidated statement of financial position and consolidated statement of cash flows
note: Printed in R thousands, stored here in absolute rand. The R129.5m provision for the GPS litigation claim is included in current liabilities and in the cash flow statement as a non-cash add-back within working capital changes, so the printed operating cash flow of R488.6m generated from operations is not reduced by it. Capital expenditure is additions of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets.
